analyst.description: Turns a request into acceptance criteria, edge cases, and an explicit out-of-scope list. Reads only.

architect.description: Weighs design options against the codebase's real constraints and recommends one. Reads only.

explorer.description: Maps unfamiliar code: locates definitions, traces flows, reports file:line. Reads only, 1M context.

implementer.description: Writes and changes code: features, bug fixes, follow-up investigation.

implementer-cx.description: Same role as implementer on a different provider. Used when implementer hits its usage limit.

tester.description: Writes tests: reproduces a bug as a failing test, covers edge cases, leaves the suite runnable.

debugger.description: Takes a symptom to its root cause with evidence, then fixes that cause.

refactorer.description: Restructures code without changing behavior: dead code, duplication, unclear boundaries.

reviewer.description: Reviews a change for defects and ranks them by consequence. Reads only.

auditor.description: Adversarial and security review: attacks the change looking for exploitable or destructive failure. Reads only.

scribe.description: Writes documentation from the code as it actually behaves: READMEs, docstrings, changelog entries.
